reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Source-provenance assessment and burden/enrichment reanalysis with technical/ancestry and testable-universe checks.

checks.quote: blinded resequencing of a balanced subset
checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior burden/enrichment Methods or versioned documentation to select detailed analysis conditions and verify transfer before execution. Citation/provenance lookup is separate.

checks.quote: blinded resequencing of a balanced subset
checks.reason: Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.
Explains aggregate variant burden, differential ascertainment and the eligible/testable-gene enrichment null rather than equating a small p-value with pathway causation.

Disappearance or loss of significance is treated as support/confirmation of artifact without comparing effect estimates and precision; reduced sample size, power or changed measurement can also cause it.

checks.quote: cases and controls are co-sequenced and ancestry-balanced
checks.reason: Specifies a genuinely independent cohort or balanced resequencing comparison, with common callability/filtering and ancestry/technical comparability; preserves association-versus-mechanism uncertainty.

checks.quote: if center and phenotype are inseparable
checks.reason: Balanced same-center resequencing, ancestry/center-constrained nulls, shared callability and independent co-sequenced cases/controls address the confounding structure.
